title: What If a 215 MPH Hurricane Hit Land?

scenes.text: What if a hurricane had winds of 215 miles an hour? In 2015, one did.
Hurricane Patricia's winds rose 120 miles an hour in a single day, from 85 to 205.
Its pressure fell to 872 millibars, the lowest ever measured in the Western Hemisphere.
A Category 5 starts at 157 miles an hour. Patricia blew past that by almost sixty.
Then it weakened fast, and hit Mexico as a Category 4 with 150 mile an hour winds.
It caused about 325 million dollars of damage and two deaths. Forecasts had missed its strength by up to 120 miles an hour.

description:
What if a hurricane with 215 mph winds hit land?
Hurricane Patricia in 2015 reached 215 mph and 872 millibars, then weakened to a Category 4 before reaching Mexico; some forecasts missed its intensity by up to 120 mph.
What should we run through next?
